title: 第17章 铁手重铸第18章 金螭剑
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
地下黑市的出口甬道内，空气黏稠沉重。
元婴期的庞大神识在众修士头顶反复扫过，虽然没有带任何威压，但那种高阶修士的绝对压迫感，依旧让大半炼气期散修手脚冰凉。
林渊站在甬道最阴暗的角落，低垂着头，匿息佩在长袍下微微发热，将他的液化灵力死死锁在气海。
他发现那股神识并非针对他一人，似乎在排查所有身上带有血腥气或近期斗法痕迹的修士。
大约数个呼吸后，出口处的恶鬼面具护卫得到了某种指令，开始放行，那股笼罩在众人头顶的庞大神识也缓缓收回。
林渊没有随着人流立刻出关。
他有着老祖两百年的修行经验，能在黑市中生存并且掌控局势的人，绝不会无放矢。
此时出去，若在迷雾大泽外撞见黑市执法队或者陈、刘两家的伏击，反而被动。
林渊转身退回了错综复杂的地下集市。
他从袖中摸出那张刚刚撕下的暗黄色求购单，目光落在“铁手”两个字上。
既然需要换取真正适合筑基期使用的飞剑，且需要隐藏身份，这位在老祖记忆中重诺的筑基初期炼器师，便是最好的选择。
顺着集市最西侧一条狭窄的石缝通道，林渊走了约莫一里地。
越往里走，四周的温度便越高，空气中开始弥漫着一股浓重的硫磺与凡铁敲击的焦糊味。
在通道尽头，立着一间用粗糙黑石垒砌的铁匠铺。
铺子没有招牌，只有一柄断裂的废铁飞剑插在门框上方。
林渊走入铺内，滚烫的热浪扑面而来。
一尊黑色的锻造炉立在中央，里面燃烧着暗红色的火焰。
炉旁站着一名中年汉子，他赤裸着上身，皮肤呈现紫铜色，左袖空荡荡的，竟是一个独臂人。
他右手握着一把沉重的铁锤，正单手敲击着一块烧红的精铁，发出一声声沉闷的“当当”声。
林渊神识扫过，发现此人暴露在外的法力波动只有炼气九层，但体内的气息却凝练异常，隐隐有一股锐利之气。

老祖的记忆没有错，此人隐匿了修为，真实实力确实在筑基初期。
“打铁不看客，要买成品去外面，要定制材料自己带。”
铁手没有抬头，右手铁锤精准地砸在精铁的杂质汇聚处，火星四溅。
林渊摘下头上的斗笠，却没有取下青铜面具。
他走上前，将那张暗黄色的求购单放在了一旁的铁案上。
“我这里有你要的东西。”林渊声音沙哑地开口。
铁手手里的铁锤微微一顿，终于抬起头。
他的长相极为普通，唯独一双眸子陷在眼窝里，亮得有些刺眼。
他扫了一眼求购单，冷淡道：“我只要蕴含纯正庚金之气的矿石，一阶的大路货不要来寻我。”
林渊没有说话，右手伸入袖中，从储物袋中取出了那枚一直温养在气海中心的黑色石块。
他轻轻将外层的石皮震碎了一角。
刹那间，一抹锋锐至极的纯正金芒在昏暗的铁匠铺内亮起。
整个铺子里的温度仿佛在这一瞬间降了几分，空气中游离的金属性灵气竟隐隐发出了利刃摩擦的轻吟。
铁手的瞳孔骤然缩成了针尖大小。
他死死盯着林渊掌心中那块只有指甲盖大小、呈淡金色半透明状的尖锐晶体，右手剧烈一颤，手中的百斤铁锤“哐当”一声砸落在地，将地面砸出一个深坑。
“上古剑胚？！”
铁手的声音不再懒散，反而带着一丝掩饰不住的沙哑与震惊。
content_en:
In the exit corridor of the underground black market, the air was thick and heavy.
The huge spiritual consciousness in the Nascent Soul stage repeatedly swept over the heads of the monks. Although it did not bring any pressure, the absolute pressure of the high-level monks still made the hands and feet of casual cultivators in the Qi Refining Stage cold.
Lin Yuan stood in the darkest corner of the corridor, his head lowered, his breath slightly heated under his robe, locking his liquefied spiritual power in the sea of ​​air.
He found that the spiritual consciousness was not targeting him alone, but seemed to be searching for all the monks who had the smell of blood or traces of recent battles.
After about a few breaths, the evil ghost mask guard at the exit received some kind of instruction and began to let go. The huge spiritual consciousness that shrouded everyone's heads also slowly withdrew.
Lin Yuan did not leave the seclusion immediately with the flow of people.
He has two hundred years of cultivation experience from his ancestor, and anyone who can survive in the black market and control the situation will never be aimless.
If you go out at this time and encounter a black market law enforcement team or an ambush from the Chen and Liu families outside the foggy swamp, you will be passive.
Lin Yuan turned around and retreated to the intricate underground market.
He took out the dark yellow purchase order form he had just torn off from his sleeve, and his eyes fell on the word "Iron Hand".
Since it is necessary to exchange for a flying sword that is truly suitable for use in the foundation-building stage, and the identity needs to be hidden, this early-stage foundation-building weapon refiner who has kept his promise in the memory of his ancestors is the best choice.
Lin Yuan walked along a narrow stone passage on the westernmost side of the market for about a mile.
The further you walked in, the higher the surrounding temperature became, and the air began to be filled with a strong smell of sulfur and the burning smell of iron.
At the end of the passage, there stood a blacksmith shop built with rough black stone.
The shop had no signboard, only a broken scrap metal flying sword stuck above the door frame.
Lin Yuan walked into the shop, and a wave of scalding heat hit his face.
A black forge stood in the center, with dark red flames burning inside.
Standing next to the stove was a middle-aged man. He was bare-chested, his skin was copper-colored, and his left sleeve was empty. He turned out to be a one-armed man.
He held a heavy hammer in his right hand and was striking a piece of red-hot fine iron with one hand, making a dull "dang-dang" sound.
Lin Yuan's spiritual consciousness swept over and found that this man's exposed mana fluctuations were only at the ninth level of Qi Refining, but the aura in his body was extremely condensed, with a faint sharp aura.
The ancestor's memory is correct. This person has hidden his cultivation, and his true strength is indeed in the early stage of foundation building.
"You don't look at the customers when you are making iron. You have to buy the finished products from outside, and you have to bring the customized materials yourself."
The iron hand didn't raise his head, and the hammer in his right hand accurately hit the spot where the impurities of the fine iron gathered, sparks flying everywhere.
Lin Yuan took off the bamboo hat on his head, but did not take off the bronze mask.
He stepped forward and placed the dark yellow purchase order on the iron case beside him.
"I have what you want here." Lin Yuan said in a hoarse voice.
The hammer in Tie Shou's hand paused for a moment before finally raising his head.
His appearance was extremely ordinary, except for his eyes, which were sunk in the eye sockets and were a bit dazzling.
He glanced at the purchase order and said coldly: "I only want ores that contain pure Gengjin energy. First-class merchants don't come looking for me."
Lin Yuan didn't speak. He reached into his sleeve with his right hand and took out the black stone that had been kept in the center of the sea of ​​qi from the storage bag.
He gently shattered a corner of the outer stone skin.
In an instant, an extremely sharp and pure golden light lit up in the dark blacksmith shop.
The temperature in the entire shop seemed to have dropped a bit at this moment, and the metallic aura floating in the air faintly let out the faint sound of sharp blades rubbing against each other.
Tie Shou's pupils suddenly shrank to the size of a pinhead.
He stared intently at the sharp, pale golden translucent crystal in Lin Yuan's palm, which was only the size of a fingernail. His right hand trembled violently, and the hundred-jin hammer in his hand hit the ground with a clang, creating a deep pit in the ground.
"Ancient sword embryo?!"
Tie Shou's voice is no longer lazy, but has a hint of sandiness that cannot be concealed.Dumb and shocked.
